name: Self Hatred
overview: Scripture reveals that self-hatred is contrary to God's design, as He created man in His own image, affirming the inherent value of every person (Genesis 1:27). Hatred, including toward oneself, stirs conflict and turmoil, whereas love brings healing and covers sins (Proverbs 10:12). The wise embrace correction and instruction, which nurture the soul, while rejecting them leads to self-despising and trouble (Proverbs 15:32; 11:17). The Lord hears the cries of the righteous and delivers them from distress, inviting believers to find refuge and restoration in Him rather than falling into self-condemnation (Psalms 34:17).
